title: Canonical restriction and coinduction exchange mates
statement: For scheme modules with derived categories [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image], define exact open restriction by the native sectionwise restriction functor and its derived adjunction. For composable ringed-space maps use the original-unit derived direct-image composition [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image-composition], and for a commutative square compose these to its canonical direct-image square. Given four categories, adjunctions L \dashv R and F \dashv G, and a square T'R \cong GT, define the exchange LTM \to T'FM as the mate of T applied to the unit of F. With T \dashv H and T' \dashv H' and invertible exchange at HN, define coinduction restriction FH N \to H'LN as the T'-adjunct of the inverse exchange followed by L applied to the evaluation counit. These formulas are independent of dualizing complexes or chart identifications; they use the component conventions of [def-trf-polynomial-duality-presentation-data].
